record.reason: KOSS formulates state selection via Kalman gain and uses spectral differentiation plus segment-wise scans; it reports copying and long-horizon forecasting gains, including near-linear hardware-oriented processing. Its evaluations are time-series/radar rather than LLMs; the SSM alternative is a plausible architecture relation but LLM inference benefit is not tested.
record.title: KOSS: Kalman-Optimal Selective State Spaces for Long-Term Sequence Modeling
